parked.spanish: No te postrarás a ellos, y no los servirás, porque yo Jehová tu Dios, Dios celoso, visitante iniquidad de padres sobre hijos, sobre terceros y sobre cuartos, a mis aborrecedores.
No alzarás el nombre de Jehová tu Dios a la vanidad, porque no dejará limpio Jehová al que alzare su nombre a la vanidad.

findings.issue: alzare es futuro de subjuntivo, forma desusada que un lector actual tendría que adivinar

parked.spanish: No harán conmigo dioses de plata y dioses de oro; no harán a ustedes.

findings.issue: וֵאלֹהֵי זָהָב is the fronted object of the second לֹא תַעֲשׂוּ. Spanish joins dioses de oro to the first clause and leaves the second harán without that object.
findings.spanishSpan: y dioses de oro; no harán

findings.issue: לָכֶם is a preposition plus 2mp suffix (for you), the beneficiary of making. a ustedes makes the addressees the thing made.

readerNotes.note: hold: clause role — the Hophal stem makes the addressee ("tú") the patient served/subjected by them, not the one serving "los", which is a who-acts-on-whom question, not a grammar fix.

Completed the participle's predicate with the simple present 'te da' rather than the periphrastic 'te está dando'; 'se alarguen' was left unchanged since it already renders the intransitive hiphil with plural días as subject, adding no causer or object.
Shofar is rendered as 'bocina' (the ram's-horn trumpet), the Spanish common-noun equivalent, since common nouns cannot stay untranslated.
Supplied *estaba* (verb 'to be') in italics to complete the verbless Hebrew relative clause; no separate source token corresponds to it.
Chose the singular 'de piedra labrada' to carry גָּזִית's own singular number separately from the plural object las piedras, rather than pluralizing the adjective to agree with las.
